title: Legacy Goat Spawning
description: A datapack that re-adds goats to the Windswept Hills (formerly 'Mountians') biome
body:
This datapack is best used with the [Global Packs](https://modrinth.com/mod/globalpacks) mod.

The datapack will allow Goats to spawn in the Windswept Hills (formerly known as 'Mountians') biomes like they did as a placeholder in 1.17. If playing with the [Moderner Beta](https://modrinth.com/mod/moderner-beta) mod, it will allow you to get Goats on any worldgen type with the ability to spawn the Windswept Hills Biome
